name: picarium-extension
description: Picarium 浏览器导入扩展（MV3 + TypeScript + esbuild）

scripts.build: esbuild src/background.ts --bundle --format=esm --target=chrome110 --outfile=dist/background.js && esbuild src/content.ts --bundle --format=iife --target=chrome110 --outfile=dist/content.js && node -e "const fs=require('node:fs');fs.copyFileSync('manifest.json','dist/manifest.json');for(const n of [16,32,48,128])fs.copyFileSync(`icons/icon${n}.png`,`dist/icon${n}.png`)"
scripts.test: esbuild test/media.test.ts test/overlay.test.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=cjs --outdir=dist-test && node --test dist-test/media.test.js dist-test/overlay.test.js
